stop: Create analysis-graphene-incremental/STOP. This does not stop the scanner or delete either STOP.
inputs: Only manifest completed records with raw TIFF, sidecar and saved substrate-label hashes. Uncommitted raw files are ignored.
identity: Pinned scan-request hash, project/run identity, source implementation and optical model hashes, source record/geometry hashes, and campaign coordinate_frame_id. A source change fails closed; it does not silently create a new lineage.
resume: Replays small per-field ledger, verifies derived output hashes and immutable source record/geometry identities. Raw TIFF hashes are verified before and after each first analysis; unchanged already-committed fields are not re-decoded or rehashed on resume.

resource_policy.qualification: RAM is checked before field allocation with a conservative2GiB analysis allowance, and at phase/component boundaries with a2.5GiB reserve abort; not an OS-enforced process cap. No5Mpx peak benchmark was run on the low-RAM acquisition host. STOP/time limits are cooperative; a native operation can finish before the next check. No DINO, microscope client, raw deletion or copied TIFF/JPEG. Drive/cache reserve checks remain active.

science.domain: Recorded chip polygon plus independently saved substrate labels; geometry remains distinct from bare-substrate color support.
science.proposal: Noise-qualified connected features are independent of optical compatibility. Unmatched features and substrate controls remain in per-field masks/results.
science.conditional_model: Published constant-index graphene film on nominal90nm SiO2/Si, finite85/90/95nm oxide, illumination NA0/.4, manufacturer typical Axiocam305 trace, equal-energy/3000K/6500K lamp scenarios under energy/photon interpretations. Actual lamp/spectral response and this run's gamma/dark offset are unmeasured. Wavelengths restricted to source trace support.
science.mismatch_allowance: Explicit1% RGB standard deviation engineering allowance, not measured uncertainty or calibrated sensitivity/specificity.
science.shortlist: Conditional optical compatibility plus25um2 area and3um usable width. All other regions remain uncertain; no chemical material or monolayer assignment.
science.revisit: Source pixel lies inside observed region; transformed stage XY is tied to raw hash, transform and coordinate frame. Manual100x change requires fresh objective calibration before any later motion.

viewer.shortlist: catalog.json rows: top1000 by rank, counts cover all committed results
viewer.all_proposals: ledger.json maps field to fields/.../field.json containing every retained region and explicit unassessable outcomes
viewer.masks: Per-field masks.npz preserves instance/parent labels, class map, compatible/unknown domain and background/saturation controls
viewer.previews: Existing RUN-root-relative chipNNN/tiles/tile_NNNNNN.jpg; no copied image

validation.command: Latest: python -m pytest tests/test_graphene_watcher.py -q --basetemp=data/gwt06. Earlier: watcher plus tests/test_material_profiles.py at gwt04.
validation.coverage: Synthetic raw pipeline, real default model construction, exact index regression, committed-only input, changed geometry/request rejection, retained unknown/background, source-bound coordinates, idempotent resume, coordinate-frame pinning, independent STOP, low-RAM yield, cooperative timeout outcome
